scripts.title: Auto Play
scripts.author: tylenol
scripts.summary: Auto Player for Symphony Ochestra.
scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

local registerHit = net:FindFirstChild("RE/RegisterHit") or net:FindFirstChild("RegisterHit")

    ["sanguine art"] = true,
}

local function melee(tool)
    if not tool or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
    if styles[tool.Name:lower()] then return true end
    local category = tostring(tool:GetAttribute("WeaponType") or tool.ToolTip or ""):lower()
    return category == "melee" or category == "fighting style"
end

local function equipMelee()
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 or melee(character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")) then return end

    local bag = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    if not bag then return end
    local choice
    for _, tool in ipairs(bag:GetChildren()) do
        if melee(tool) then
            choice = tool
            if tool.Name:lower() == "combat" then break end
        end
    end
    if choice then humanoid:EquipTool(choice) end
end

local function characterRoot()
    local character = player.Character
    local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then return root end
end

local function attack(mob)
    local root = characterRoot()
    local tool = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
    if not root or not mob or not tool or not melee(tool) then return end
    if not registerAttack or not registerHit then return end

    local hits, primary, closest = {}, nil, math.huge
    for _, enemy in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
        if enemy.Name == mob.Name and enemy:IsA("Model") then
            local humanoid = enemy:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local targetRoot = enemy:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and targetRoot then
                local distance = (targetRoot.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if distance <= range then
                    if distance < closest then
                        closest = distance
                        primary = enemy:FindFirstChild("Head") or targetRoot
                    end
                    for _, part in ipairs(enemy:GetChildren()) do
                        if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                            hits[#hits + 1] = {enemy, part}
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if primary then
        pcall(function()
            registerAttack:FireServer(0.0001)
            registerHit:FireServer(primary, hits)
        end)
    end
end

local function level()
    local data = player:FindFirstChild("Data")
    local value = data and data:FindFirstChild("Level")
    return value and value.Value or 1
end

local function currentQuest()
    local currentLevel = level()
    for _, quest in ipairs(quests[sea]) do
        if currentLevel >= quest.min and currentLevel <= quest.max then
            return quest
        end
    end
end

local function questShown()
    local gui = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
    local main = gui and gui:FindFirstChild("Main")
    local frame = main and (main:FindFirstChild("Quest") or main:FindFirstChild("Quest", true))
    if not frame or not frame:IsA("GuiObject") or not frame.Visible then return false end
    local parent = frame.Parent
    while parent and parent ~= main do
        if parent:IsA("GuiObject") and not parent.Visible then return false end
        parent = parent.Parent
    end
    return true
end

local questMissingSince
local lastQuestAttempt = -math.huge
local function startQuest(quest)
    if questShown() then
        questMissingSince = nil
        return
    end

    local now = os.clock()
    if not questMissingSince then
        questMissingSince = now
        return
    end
    if now - questMissingSince < 2 or now - lastQuestAttempt < 5 then return end

    lastQuestAttempt = now
    pcall(function()
        comm:InvokeServer("StartQuest", quest.id, quest.index)
    end)
end

local function findMob(name)
    local root = characterRoot()
    if not root then return end
    local closest, target, prefix = math.huge, nil, name .. " ["
    for _, mob in ipairs(enemies:GetChildren()) do
        if mob.Name == name or mob.Name:sub(1, #prefix) == prefix then
            local humanoid = mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local part = mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if humanoid and part and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local distance = (part.Position - root.Position).Magnitude
                if distance < closest then
                    closest, target = distance, mob
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

local function moveTo(quest, mob)
    local root = characterRoot()
    if not root then return end

    while running and root.Parent and characterRoot() == root and currentQuest() == quest do
        local targetRoot = mob and mob:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local targetHumanoid = mob and mob:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if mob and (not targetRoot or not targetHumanoid or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0) then break end

        local goal = (targetRoot and targetRoot.Position or quest.position.Position) + offset
        local direction = goal - root.Position
        local distance = direction.Magnitude
        if distance <= 5 then
            if mob then attack(mob) end
            break
        end

        local length = math.min(distance, 50)
        local nextPosition = root.Position + direction.Unit * length
        local tween = tweens:Create(root, TweenInfo.new(length / speed, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
            CFrame = CFrame.new(nextPosition)
        })
        local done = false
        local connection = tween.Completed:Connect(function() done = true end)
        tween:Play()

        repeat
            task.wait(0.12)
            if mob then attack(mob) end
        until done or not running or characterRoot() ~= root or currentQuest() ~= quest
            or (mob and (not mob.Parent or targetHumanoid.Health <= 0))

        if not done then tween:Cancel() end
        connection:Disconnect()
        if not running or characterRoot() ~= root then break end
    end
end

    if not running or not player.Character then return end
    for _, part in ipairs(player.Character:GetDescendants()) do
        if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
    end
end)

local function connectPopup(signal, callback)
    local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
    popupConnections[#popupConnections + 1] = connection
    return connection
end

local function disconnectPopup()
    for _, connection in ipairs(popupConnections) do
        connection:Disconnect()
    end
    table.clear(popupConnections)
end

local function makeDiscordPopup()
    local parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
    local previous = parent:FindFirstChild("AxonicBloxFruitsDiscord")
    if previous then previous:Destroy() end

    local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    gui.Name = "AxonicBloxFruitsDiscord"
    gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.DisplayOrder = 100
    gui.Parent = parent
    discordGui = gui

    local theme = {
        Window = Color3.fromRGB(13, 13, 15),
        Header = Color3.fromRGB(17, 17, 20),
        Card = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 24),
        Button = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 26),
        Hover = Color3.fromRGB(29, 30, 35),
        Border = Color3.fromRGB(40, 41, 47),
        BorderBright = Color3.fromRGB(64, 66, 75),
        Text = Color3.fromRGB(242, 243, 246),
        Muted = Color3.fromRGB(156, 158, 167),
        Faint = Color3.fromRGB(98, 100, 109),
    }

    local function make(class, props, parentObj)
        local instance = Instance.new(class)
        for key, value in pairs(props) do instance[key] = value end
        instance.Parent = parentObj
        return instance
    end

    local function round(obj, amount)
        make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, amount)}, obj)
    end

    local function outline(obj, color, transparency)
        make("UIStroke", {
            Color = color, Transparency = transparency or 0, Thickness = 1,
        }, obj)
    end

    local function label(obj, value, x, y, w, h, size, color, font)
        return make("TextLabel", {
            Position = UDim2.new(0, x, 0, y),
            Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h),
            BackgroundTransparency = 1,
            Text = value,
            TextColor3 = color,
            TextSize = size,
            Font = font or Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
        }, obj)
    end

    local width, height = 360, 240
    local panel = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Window",
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(.5, .5),
        Position = UDim2.fromScale(.5, .5),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(width, height),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Window,
        ClipsDescendants = true,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, gui)
    round(panel, 7)
    outline(panel, theme.BorderBright, .34)
    local scale = make("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, panel)

    local header = make("Frame", {
        Name = "Header",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 49),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, panel)
    round(header, 7)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 7),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -7),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Header,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)
    make("Frame", {
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Border,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, header)

    label(header, "Axonic", 15, 6, 220, 20, 15, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamBold)
    label(header, "Blox Fruits  /  Open Source", 15, 26, 225, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local dragHandle = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "DragHandle",
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -48, 1, 0),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = "",
        Active = true,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        ZIndex = 2,
    }, header)

    local close = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "Close",
        Position = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 11),
        Size = UDim2.fromOffset(27, 27),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        Text = "×",
        TextSize = 15,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        TextColor3 = theme.Muted,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        ZIndex = 3,
    }, header)
    round(close, 3)
    outline(close, theme.Border, .3)
    close.MouseEnter:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    close.MouseLeave:Connect(function() close.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    close.Activated:Connect(function()
        gui:Destroy()
        discordGui = nil
        disconnectPopup()
    end)

    local dragging = false
    local dragStart, startPosition, touchInput
    dragHandle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        local kind = input.UserInputType
        if kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and kind ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = panel.Position
        touchInput = kind == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input or nil
    end)

    connectPopup(UserInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
        if not dragging or not panel.Parent then return end
        if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input ~= touchInput then return end
        local viewport = workspace.CurrentCamera and workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport then return end
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        local halfWidth = panel.AbsoluteSize.X * .5
        local halfHeight = panel.AbsoluteSize.Y * .5
        local centerX = viewport.X * startPosition.X.Scale + startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X
        local centerY = viewport.Y * startPosition.Y.Scale + startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
        panel.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(
            math.clamp(centerX, math.min(halfWidth + 8, viewport.X * .5), math.max(viewport.X - halfWidth - 8, viewport.X * .5)),
            math.clamp(centerY, math.min(halfHeight + 8, viewport.Y * .5), math.max(viewport.Y - halfHeight - 8, viewport.Y * .5))
        )
    end)
    connectPopup(UserInputService.InputEnded, function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input == touchInput then
            dragging = false
            touchInput = nil
        end
    end)

    label(panel, "OPEN-SOURCE SCRIPTS", 15, 59, 220, 14, 10, theme.Faint, Enum.Font.GothamBold)

    for index, name in ipairs({"Blox Fruits", "Murder Mystery 2", "RIVALS"}) do
        local row = make("Frame", {
            Name = "Game" .. index,
            Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 79 + (index - 1) * 33),
            Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 29),
            BackgroundColor3 = theme.Card,
            BorderSizePixel = 0,
        }, panel)
        round(row, 3)
        outline(row, theme.Border, .27)
        label(row, name, 13, 0, 285, 29, 12, theme.Text, Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
    end

    label(panel, "discord.gg/axonic", 15, 184, 180, 13, 10, theme.Muted)

    local copyButton = make("TextButton", {
        Name = "CopyDiscordInvite",
        Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 204),
        Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 28),
        BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Text = "COPY DISCORD",
        TextSize = 11,
        TextColor3 = theme.Text,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
        AutoButtonColor = false,
    }, panel)
    round(copyButton, 4)
    outline(copyButton, theme.BorderBright, .3)
    copyButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Hover end)
    copyButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function() copyButton.BackgroundColor3 = theme.Button end)
    copyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
        local clipboard = setclipboard or toclipboard
        local copied = type(clipboard) == "function" and pcall(clipboard, "https://discord.gg/axonic")
        copyButton.Text = copied and "COPIED" or "discord.gg/axonic"
    end)

    local lastViewport
    local function fit()
        local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
        local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize
        if not viewport or viewport == lastViewport then return end
        lastViewport = viewport
        scale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min((viewport.X - 24) / width, (viewport.Y - 24) / height), .6, 1)
    end
    fit()
    connectPopup(runService.RenderStepped, function()
        if gui.Parent then fit() end
    end)
end


local popupOk, popupError = pcall(makeDiscordPopup)
if not popupOk then warn("[Axonic] Discord popup:", popupError) end

task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        task.wait(0.15)
        local root = characterRoot()
        local quest = currentQuest()
        if root and quest then
            equipMelee()
            startQuest(quest)
            local mob = findMob(quest.mob)
            if mob then
                moveTo(quest, mob)
            else
                moveTo(quest)
            end
        end
    end
end)

env.AxonicRawBloxFruitsStop = function()
    running = false
    noclip:Disconnect()
    disconnectPopup()
    if discordGui then discordGui:Destroy() end
end

scripts.title: Reset in ANY GAME and its KEYLESS
scripts.author: BTWthisUSERisINuseH
scripts.summary: Fun for when you want to troll, like when you are getting abused by an admin and get frozen in a game where you can't reset, well, reset!
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

-- Clean up any previously running instance of this script
local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if env.ForceResetCleanup then
    pcall(env.ForceResetCleanup)
    env.ForceResetCleanup = nil
end

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Active = true

-- Create a custom BindableEvent to handle the Reset button click
local ResetBindable = Instance.new("BindableEvent")

local function doRespawn()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end

    -- Method 1: Break joints / set health to 0 (works in 95% of games)
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if hum then
        hum.Health = 0
    end
    char:BreakJoints()

    -- Method 2: Fallback if the game blocks Humanoid death on the client
    task.delay(0.4, function()
        if LocalPlayer.Character == char and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
            local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root then
                -- Drop below the workspace FallenPartsDestroyHeight to force server deletion
                root.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight - 50, 0)
            end
        end
    end)
end

ResetBindable.Event:Connect(doRespawn)

-- Function to force-enable the button in the Esc menu
local function applyResetCallback()
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("ResetButtonCallback", ResetBindable)
    end)
end

-- Apply immediately
applyResetCallback()

-- Keep enforcing it in case the game tries to disable it again on spawn or loop
local loopConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
    if not Active then return end
    applyResetCallback()
end)

-- Register cleanup so re-running overwrites cleanly
env.ForceResetCleanup = function()
    Active = false
    if loopConn and loopConn.Connected then
        loopConn:Disconnect()
    end
    if ResetBindable then
        ResetBindable:Destroy()
    end
    pcall(function()
        StarterGui:SetCore("ResetButtonCallback", true)
    end)
end

pcall(function()
    StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
        Title = "Respawn Enabled";
        Text = "Esc menu Reset Character button is now active.";
        Duration = 3;
    })
end)

local keyMap = {
	["0"] = Enum.KeyCode.Zero, ["1"] = Enum.KeyCode.One, ["2"] = Enum.KeyCode.Two,
	["3"] = Enum.KeyCode.Three, ["4"] = Enum.KeyCode.Four, ["5"] = Enum.KeyCode.Five,
	["6"] = Enum.KeyCode.Six, ["7"] = Enum.KeyCode.Seven, ["8"] = Enum.KeyCode.Eight,
	["9"] = Enum.KeyCode.Nine, ["SPACE"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["SPACEBAR"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space,
	[" "] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["LEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["ARROWLEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left,
	["←"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["RIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["ARROWRIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right,
	["→"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["UP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["ARROWUP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up,
	["↑"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["DOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, ["ARROWDOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down,
	["↓"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, [";"] = Enum.KeyCode.Semicolon, ["'"] = Enum.KeyCode.Quote,
	[","] = Enum.KeyCode.Comma, ["."] = Enum.KeyCode.Period, ["/"] = Enum.KeyCode.Slash,
	["\\"] = Enum.KeyCode.BackSlash, ["["] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket, ["]"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket,
	["-"] = Enum.KeyCode.Minus, ["="] = Enum.KeyCode.Equals, ["LSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift,
	["RSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, ["LCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, ["RCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
}

local enumList = Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()

local function parseKey(txt)
	if type(txt) ~= "string" then return nil, "?" end
	local s = txt:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if s == "" then return nil, "?" end
	s = s:gsub("^Enum%.KeyCode%.", "")
	local br = s:match("^%[(.-)%]$")
	if br then s = br:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
	local up = s:upper()

	if keyMap[up] then return keyMap[up], s end

	local ok1, e1 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[s] end)
	if ok1 and typeof(e1) == "EnumItem" then return e1, s end

	local ok2, e2 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[up] end)
	if ok2 and typeof(e2) == "EnumItem" then return e2, up end

	for _, v in ipairs(enumList) do
		if v.Name:upper() == up then
			return v, v.Name
		end
	end
	return nil, s
end

local function grabKey(rec)
	local k = rec:FindFirstChild("Key")
	local raw
	if k then
		if k:IsA("TextLabel") or k:IsA("TextButton") or k:IsA("TextBox") then
			raw = k.Text
		elseif k:IsA("StringValue") then
			raw = k.Value
		elseif k:IsA("IntValue") or k:IsA("NumberValue") then
			raw = tostring(k.Value)
		end
	end
	if (not raw or raw == "") and rec:GetAttribute("Key") ~= nil then
		raw = tostring(rec:GetAttribute("Key"))
	end
	return parseKey(raw)
end

local hasFire = type(firesignal) == "function"
local hasConns = type(getconnections) == "function"

local function fireSig(sig, ...)
	if hasFire then
		pcall(firesignal, sig, ...)
	elseif hasConns then
		local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
		if ok and type(list) == "table" then
			for _, c in ipairs(list) do
				if c.Enabled ~= false then
					if type(c.Fire) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Fire, c, ...)
					elseif type(c.Function) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Function, ...)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function gotConns(sig)
	if not hasConns then return false end
	local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
	return ok and type(list) == "table" and #list > 0
end

local function midOf(b)
	local p, sz = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
	return p.X + sz.X * 0.5, p.Y + sz.Y * 0.5
end

local function pressBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Down) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputBegan) then
		fireSig(b.InputBegan, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent then
		if gotConns(b.Activated) then
			fireSig(b.Activated, {
				UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
				UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
				Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			}, 1)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.MouseButton1Click) then
			fireSig(b.MouseButton1Click)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.TouchTap) then
			fireSig(b.TouchTap, { Vector2.new(x, y) })
			sent = true
		end
	end
	if not sent and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
	end
end

local function releaseBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Up) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputEnded) then
		fireSig(b.InputEnded, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.End,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent and not hasConns and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
	end
end

local on = false
local mode = "Touch"
local off = 0
local hits = 0
local fc = 0

local seen = {}
local tailsHeld = {}
local notesHeld = {}
local relAt = {}
local down = {}

local function rel(idx)
	local d = down[idx]
	if not d then return end
	down[idx] = nil
	if d.m == "Key" and d.k then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, d.k, false, game) end)
	elseif d.m == "Touch" and d.b and d.b.Parent then
		releaseBtn(d.b)
	end
end

local function press(info)
	local idx = info.idx
	if down[idx] then rel(idx) end
	if mode == "Touch" then
		if not info.btn then return false end
		down[idx] = { m = "Touch", b = info.btn }
		pressBtn(info.btn)
		return true
	else
		if not info.key then return false end
		down[idx] = { m = "Key", k = info.key }
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, info.key, false, game) end)
		return true
	end
end

local function clearAll()
	for i in pairs(down) do rel(i) end
	table.clear(tailsHeld)
	table.clear(notesHeld)
	table.clear(relAt)
	table.clear(seen)
end

local function syncChips(lanes)

		t[#t + 1] = v.idx .. ":" .. (if mode == "Touch" then ("L" .. v.idx) else v.lbl)

local function checkHit(obj, rec)
	local gp, gs = obj.AbsolutePosition, obj.AbsoluteSize
	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	if gs.X <= 1 or gs.Y <= 1 or rs.X <= 1 or rs.Y <= 1 then return false, false end

	local cx = gp.X + gs.X * 0.5
	if cx < rp.X or cx > (rp.X + rs.X) then return false, false end

	local hit = (gp.Y + gs.Y >= rp.Y - off) and (gp.Y <= rp.Y + rs.Y)
	return hit, gs.Y > (rs.Y * 1.6)
end

local function findTail(note, rec, tails)
	local np, ns = note.AbsolutePosition, note.AbsoluteSize
	local nt, nb = np.Y, np.Y + ns.Y
	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	local rl, rr = rp.X, rp.X + rs.X

	local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
	for _, tl in ipairs(tails) do
		if tl.Visible then
			local tp, ts = tl.AbsolutePosition, tl.AbsoluteSize
			if ts.X > 1 and ts.Y > 1 then
				local tx = tp.X + ts.X * 0.5
				if tx >= rl and tx <= rr then
					local tt, tb = tp.Y, tp.Y + ts.Y
					if tb >= (nt - 40) and tt <= (nb + 40) then
						local d = math.abs(tb - nt)
						if d < bestD then
							bestD = d
							best = tl
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function getBtn(lane, rec)
	if lane:IsA("GuiButton") then return lane end
	if rec:IsA("GuiButton") then return rec end
	return lane:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton") or rec:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiButton")
end

local function scanLanes(hw)
	local out = {}
	for _, ch in ipairs(hw:GetChildren()) do
		local n = ch.Name:match("^Lane(%d+)$")
		if n and ch:IsA("GuiObject") and ch.Visible then
			local rec = ch:FindFirstChild("Receptor")
			if rec and rec:IsA("GuiObject") and rec.Visible then
				local kc, kl = grabKey(rec)
				out[#out + 1] = {
					idx = tonumber(n),
					lane = ch,
					rec = rec,
					btn = getBtn(ch, rec),
					key = kc,
					lbl = kl,
				}
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.idx < b.idx end)
	return out
end

local loop = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	fc += 1

	for idx, chp in pairs(chips) do
		chp.BackgroundColor3 = if down[idx] then uikit.Colors.Gold else uikit.Colors.Raised
	end

	local og = pg:FindFirstChild("OrchestraGui")
	local hw = og and og:FindFirstChild("Highway")

	if not og or not og.Enabled or not hw or not hw.Visible then
		if on then
			clearAll()
			stLbl.Text = "Status: Waiting for song..."
		end
		return
	end

	local lanes = scanLanes(hw)
	if #lanes == 0 then
		if on then
			clearAll()
			stLbl.Text = "Status: No receptors found"
		end
		return
	end

	syncChips(lanes)
	if not on then return end

	local byIdx = {}
	for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do byIdx[v.idx] = v end

	for idx in pairs(down) do
		if not byIdx[idx] then
			rel(idx)
			tailsHeld[idx] = nil
			notesHeld[idx] = nil
			relAt[idx] = nil
		end
	end

	stLbl.Text = string.format("Running [%s] (%dL)", mode, #lanes)

	for _, v in ipairs(lanes) do
		local i = v.idx
		local ht = tailsHeld[i]
		if ht then
			local t = ht.t
			if not t.Parent or not t.Visible or t.AbsoluteSize.X <= 1 or t.AbsoluteSize.Y <= 1 then
				tailsHeld[i] = nil
				rel(i)
			else
				if checkHit(t, v.rec) then
					ht.inRec = true
				elseif ht.inRec or (fc - ht.sf) > 35 then
					tailsHeld[i] = nil
					rel(i)
				end
			end
		elseif notesHeld[i] then
			local hn = notesHeld[i]
			if not hn.Parent or not hn.Visible then
				notesHeld[i] = nil
				rel(i)
			end
		elseif relAt[i] and fc >= relAt[i] then
			relAt[i] = nil
			rel(i)
		end
	end

local rs, plrs, ws = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("Workspace")
local lp = plrs.LocalPlayer

local chukunhax = {
	silent = true,
	hitchance = 80,
	corner = 78,
	spread = 1.4,
	perfectcharge = true,
	tackleaim = true,
	stamina = true,
}

local function mod(...)
	local n = rs
	for _, v in ipairs({ ... }) do n = n and n:FindFirstChild(v) end
	local ok, m = pcall(require, n)
	return ok and m or nil
end

local proto = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionRemoteProtocol")
local cmds = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionCommands")
local sprint = mod("Modules", "Actions", "Sprint")
local teams = mod("Client", "Gameplay", "ActorTeams")
local match = mod("Modules", "Gameplay", "MatchSettings")

local function getroot(c)
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function goals()
	local d = ws:FindFirstChild("Map") and ws.Map:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local a, b = d and d:FindFirstChild("Team1"), d and d:FindFirstChild("Team2")
	return a and a:FindFirstChild("Goal"), b and b:FindFirstChild("Goal")
end

local function enemygoal()
	local a, b = goals()
	if not (a and b) then return a or b end
	local ok, mine = pcall(teams.GetCharacterTeamName, lp.Character)
	local ok2, opp = ok and pcall(match.GetOpposingTeamName, mine)
	if ok2 and opp == "Team1" then return a end
	if ok2 and opp == "Team2" then return b end
	local r = getroot(lp.Character)
	if not r then return a end
	return (a.Position - r.Position).Magnitude > (b.Position - r.Position).Magnitude and a or b
end

local function keeper(goal)
	local best, dist = nil, 1e9
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			local d = (r.Position - goal.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = r, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function spot(goal)
	local side = math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1
	local k = keeper(goal)
	if k then side = goal.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(k.Position).X > 0 and -1 or 1 end
	local x = side * goal.Size.X / 2 * (chukunhax.corner / 100)
	local y = goal.Size.Y / 2 * 0.8
	local jx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * chukunhax.spread
	local jy = (math.random() - 0.5) * chukunhax.spread
	return (goal.CFrame * CFrame.new(x + jx, y + jy, 0)).Position
end

local function isshot(c)
	if c.Mode == "Volley" then return true end
	if cmds and typeof(cmds.IsVolley) == "function" then
		local ok, v = pcall(cmds.IsVolley, c)
		if ok and v then return true end
	end
	return c.PassType == "Shot"
end

local function closest()
	local me = getroot(lp.Character)
	local best, dist = nil, 25
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r and me then
			local d = (r.Position - me.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = p, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function aimat(c, pos)
	local aim = c.AimDirection
	local has = typeof(aim) == "table"
	local origin = has and aim.Origin
	if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then
		local r = getroot(lp.Character)
		origin = r and r.Position
	end
	if not origin or (pos - origin).Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
	local dir = (pos - origin).Unit
	if has then
		aim.TargetPosition = pos
		aim.Direction = dir
	end
	c.TargetPosition = pos
	local flat = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 0 then c.KickDirection = flat.Unit end
end

local function edit(c)
	if chukunhax.perfectcharge and c.MaximumChargeSeconds then
		c.ChargeSeconds = c.MaximumChargeSeconds
	end
	if chukunhax.silent and isshot(c) and math.random(100) <= chukunhax.hitchance then
		local g = enemygoal()
		if g then aimat(c, spot(g)) end
	end
	if chukunhax.tackleaim and cmds and c.Kind == cmds.Kinds.Tackle and typeof(c.AimDirection) == "table" then
		local p = closest()
		local r = p and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			c.AimDirection.ClientHit = { Kind = "Player", UserId = p.UserId }
			c.TargetUserId = p.UserId
			aimat(c, r.Position)
		end
	end
end

for _, name in ipairs({ "Send", "Start", "Update", "Release" }) do
	local og = proto[name]
	if typeof(og) == "function" then
		proto[name] = function(c, ...)
			if typeof(c) == "table" then pcall(edit, c) end
			return og(c, ...)
		end
	end
end

if chukunhax.stamina and sprint and sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina then
	pcall(sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina, lp, "hax", true)
end

scripts.code:
local Players, RS = game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local lp, cam = Players.LocalPlayer, workspace.CurrentCamera

local CFG = { fov = 160, hitChance = 85, headChance = 55, wallcheck = true, players = true, bots = true }

local FIRE = {}
for _, n in ipairs({ "FireRifle", "FireSMG", "FireLMG", "FirePistol", "FireDMR", "FireSniper", "FireShotgun" }) do
	local r = RS.Voxel.Remotes:FindFirstChild(n)
	if r then FIRE[r] = n end
end
local Ballistics = require(RS.Voxel.Ballistics)

local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

local function alive(model)
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return hum and hum.Health > 0 and model:GetAttribute("Alive") ~= false
end

local function pick()
	local center, best, bestDist = cam.ViewportSize / 2, nil, CFG.fov
	local myTeam = tostring(lp.Team)
	local function consider(model)
		local root = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root or not alive(model) then return end
		local p, on = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(root.Position)
		if not on then return end
		local d = (Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center).Magnitude
		if d >= bestDist then return end
		if CFG.wallcheck then
			params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { lp.Character, model }
			if workspace:Raycast(cam.CFrame.Position, root.Position - cam.CFrame.Position, params) then return end
		end
		best, bestDist = model, d
	end
	if CFG.players then
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if pl ~= lp and pl.Character and (pl.Team == nil or pl.Team ~= lp.Team) then consider(pl.Character) end
		end
	end
	local rigs = CFG.bots and workspace:FindFirstChild("BotRigs")
	if rigs then
		for _, m in ipairs(rigs:GetChildren()) do
			if m:GetAttribute("Team") ~= myTeam then consider(m) end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function rewrite(name, a)
	local muzzle = a[1]
	if typeof(muzzle) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(a[2]) ~= "Vector3" then return end
	if math.random(100) > CFG.hitChance then return end
	local model = pick()
	if not model then return end
	local part = model:FindFirstChild(math.random(100) <= CFG.headChance and "Head" or "UpperTorso")
	if not part then return end

	local speed, arc = Ballistics.SPEED or 1700, nil
	if name == "FireSniper" then
		local tool = lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		speed = Ballistics.RIFLE_SPEED * ((tool and tonumber(tool:GetAttribute("GsVelocity"))) or 1)
		arc = Ballistics.RIFLE_ARC
	end

	local point = part.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12), math.random(-12, 12)) / 100
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if root and root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude > 0.5 then
		local dist = (point - muzzle).Magnitude
		local ok, t = pcall(Ballistics.flightTime, dist, speed, arc)
		point += root.AssemblyLinearVelocity * (ok and t or dist / speed)
	end

	local plain = (point - muzzle).Unit
	local aim = plain
	if name == "FireSniper" then
		local ok, v = pcall(Ballistics.launch, muzzle, point, speed, arc)
		if ok and typeof(v) == "Vector3" and v.Magnitude > 0.5 then aim = v.Unit end
	end

	if name == "FireShotgun" then
		for i = 3, #a do if typeof(a[i]) == "Vector3" then a[i] = plain end end
	else
		a[2] = aim
		if typeof(a[4]) == "Vector3" then a[4] = plain end
		if typeof(a[5]) == "number" then a[5] = 0 end
	end
end

local old
old = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
	local method = getnamecallmethod()
	local name = method == "FireServer" and FIRE[self]
	if name then
		local a, n = { ... }, select("#", ...)
		pcall(rewrite, name, a)
		setnamecallmethod(method)
		return old(self, table.unpack(a, 1, n))
	end
	return old(self, ...)
end))

local function draggable(frame,handle)  
	local dragging = false  
	local dragStart  
	local startPos  
  
	handle.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)  
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then  
  
			dragging = true  
			dragStart = input.Position  
			startPos = frame.Position  
  
			input.Changed:Connect(function()  
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then  
					dragging = false  
				end  
			end)  
		end  
	end)  
  
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)  
		if dragging and (  
			input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement  
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch  
		) then  
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart  
			frame.Position = UDim2.new(  
				startPos.X.Scale,  
				startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,  
				startPos.Y.Scale,  
				startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y  
			)  
		end  
	end)  
end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end

    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)

            else

        end
    end
end

local function createDropdownOptions()
    local totalHeight = 0
    
    for index, option in ipairs(dropdownOptions) do
        local optionButton = Instance.new("TextButton", G2L["DropdownScroll"])
        optionButton["BorderSizePixel"] = 0
        optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        optionButton["Size"] = UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 28)
        optionButton["Position"] = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, (index - 1) * 28 + 4)
        optionButton["Text"] = option
        optionButton["TextSize"] = 12
        optionButton["TextColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        optionButton["FontFace"] = Font.new([[rbxasset://fonts/families/ComicNeueAngular.json]], Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
        optionButton["ZIndex"] = 27
        
        local optionCorner = Instance.new("UICorner", optionButton)
        optionCorner["CornerRadius"] = UDim.new(0, 3)
        
        optionButton.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
            optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
        end)
        
        optionButton.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
            optionButton["BackgroundColor3"] = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 45)
        end)
        
        optionButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
            currentAI = option
            G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"]["Text"] = option
            G2L["TextBox_f"]["PlaceholderText"] = "Ask " .. option .. " anything..."
            G2L["DropdownFrame"]["Visible"] = false
            
            AddMessage("System", "Switched to " .. option .. " AI model", false)
        end)
        
        totalHeight = totalHeight + 28
    end
    
    G2L["DropdownScroll"]["CanvasSize"] = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, totalHeight + 8)
end

    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        if G2L["DropdownFrame"]["Visible"] then
            local mouse = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
            local ddFrame = G2L["DropdownFrame"]
            local buttonSize = G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"].AbsoluteSize
            local buttonPos = G2L["TextButton_SelectAI"].AbsolutePosition
            local ddSize = ddFrame.AbsoluteSize
            local ddPos = ddFrame.AbsolutePosition
            
            local mouseX = mouse.X
            local mouseY = mouse.Y
            
            if not (mouseX >= buttonPos.X and mouseX <= buttonPos.X + buttonSize.X and
                    mouseY >= buttonPos.Y and mouseY <= buttonPos.Y + buttonSize.Y) and
               not (mouseX >= ddPos.X and mouseX <= ddPos.X + ddSize.X and
                    mouseY >= ddPos.Y and mouseY <= ddPos.Y + ddSize.Y) then
                G2L["DropdownFrame"]["Visible"] = false
            end
        end
    end
end)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

        for i = 1, Amount do

            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else

    end

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)

    if closest then

        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")

                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

funcs.crypt.hex.encode = function(txt)
 txt = tostring(txt)
 local hex = ''
 for i = 1, #txt do
    hex = hex .. string.format("%02x", string.byte(txt, i))
 end
 return hex
end
funcs.crypt.hex.decode = function(hex)
    hex = tostring(hex)
    local text = ""
    for i = 1, #hex, 2 do
        local byte_str = string.sub(hex, i, i+1)
        local byte = tonumber(byte_str, 16)
        text = text .. string.char(byte)
    end
    return text
end

funcs.crypt.url.decode = function(a)
    a = tostring(a)
    a = string.gsub(a, "+", " ")
    a = string.gsub(a, "%%(%x%x)", function(hex)
        return string.char(tonumber(hex, 16))
    end)
    a = string.gsub(a, "\r\n", "\n")
    return a
end
funcs.crypt.generatekey = function(optionalSize)
 local key = ''
 local a = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
 for i = 1, optionalSize or 32 do local n = math.random(1, #a) key = key .. a:sub(n, n) end
 return funcs.base64.encode(key)
end
funcs.crypt.generatebytes = function(size)

end
funcs.crypt.encrypt = function(a, b)
 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end
 return table.concat(result)
end

funcs.isexecutorclosure = function(fnc)
    local found = false
    for i, v in pairs(getgenv()) do
     if v == fnc then return true end
    end
    for i = 1, math.huge do
        local s, env = pcall(getfenv, i)
        if not s or found then break end
        if type(env) == "table" then
            for _, v in pairs(env) do
                if v == fnc then
                    found = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if found then break end
    end

    return found
end

funcs.writefile = function(path, content)
 local Path = path:split('/')
 local CurrentPath = {}
 for i = 1, #Path do
  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/') .. '/'] = files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')]
  elseif i == #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = tostring(content)
  end
 end
end

funcs.listfiles = function(path)
    if not path or path == '' then
     local Files = {}
     for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if #i:split('/') == 1 then table.insert(Files, i) end
     end
     return Files
    end
    if type(files[path]) ~= 'table' then return error(path .. ' is not a folder.') end
    local Files = {}
    for i, v in pairs(files) do

    end
    return Files
end

funcs.Drawing.new = function(Type) -- Drawing.new
    local baseProps = {
     Visible = false,
     Color = Color3.new(0,0,0),
     ClassName = nil
    }
    if Type == 'Line' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            From = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            To = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateLine = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             local from = self.From
             local to = self.To
             local distance = (to - from).Magnitude
             local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(to.Y - from.Y, to.X - from.X))

             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, self.Thickness)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, from.X, 0, from.Y)
             a.Rotation = angle
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Size = UDim2.new(0, (self.To - self.From).Magnitude, 0, value)
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' and value <= 1 then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value
            elseif key == 'From' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            elseif key == 'To' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            end
        end
        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Square' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", DrawingDict)
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local b = Instance.new("UIStroke", a)
        b.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        b.Enabled = true

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Size = Vector2.new(0,0),
            Position = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateSquare = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Size.X, 0, self.Size.Y)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, self.Position.X, 0, self.Position.Y)
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Filled' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                b.Enabled = not value
                a.BackgroundTransparency = value and 0 or 1
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
                b.Color = value
            elseif key == 'Position' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateSquare()
            elseif key == 'Size' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateSquare()
            end
        end
        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Circle' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local b = Instance.new("UIStroke", a)
        b.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        b.Enabled = false
        b.Thickness = 1
        local c = Instance.new("UICorner", a)
        c.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            Filled = false,
            NumSides = 0,
            Radius = 1,
            Position = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateCircle = function(self)
             if not b or not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Radius, 0, self.Radius)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, self.Position.X, 0, self.Position.Y)
             b.Enabled = not self
             b.Color = self.Color
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                b.Thickness = value
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
                a.Color = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value
            elseif key == 'Position' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateCircle()
            elseif key == 'Radius' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateCircle()
            elseif key == 'NumSides' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Filled' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateCircle()
            end
        end
        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Text' then
        local a = Instance.new("TextLabel", DrawingDict)
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0
        a.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.new(0,0,0)
        a.TextStrokeTransparency = 1

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Text = '',
            Transparency = 0,
            Size = 0,
            Center = false,
            Outline = false,
            OutlineColor = Color3.new(0,0,0),
            Position = Vector2.new(0,0),
            Font = 3,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateText = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             a.TextScaled = true
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Size * 3, 0, self.Size / 2)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, self.Position.X, 0, self.Position.Y)
             a.Text = self.Text
             a.Font = Fonts[self.Font]
             a.Visible = self.Visible
             a.TextColor3 = self.Color
             a.TextTransparency = 1 - self.Transparency
             a.BorderSizePixel = self.Outline and 1 or 0
             if self.Center then
              a.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
              a.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
             else
              a.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
              a.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
             end
             a.TextStrokeTransparency = self.Outline and 0 or 1
             a.TextStrokeColor3 = self.OutlineColor
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Text' and typeof(value) == 'string' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Position' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Size' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Outline' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Center' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'OutlineColor' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Font' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            end
            self:updateText()
        end

        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Image' then
        local a = Instance.new("ImageLabel", DrawingDict)
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.ImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255,255,255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = 'Image'
        meta.__index = {
            Text = '',
            Transparency = 0,
            Size = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Position = Vector2.new(0,0),
            Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
            Image = '',
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy()
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do
                if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end
               end
               a:Destroy()
            end,
            updateImage = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Size.X, 0, self.Size.Y)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, self.Position.X, 0, self.Position.Y)
             a.Visible = self.Visible
             a.ImageColor3 = self.Color
             a.ImageTransparency = 1 - self.Transparency
             a.BorderSizePixel = self.Outline and 1 or 0
             a.Image = self.Image
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Position' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Size' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            elseif key == 'Image' and typeof(value) == 'string' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
            else
             return
            end
            self:updateImage()
        end

        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    end
end

funcs.rconsoleprint = function(msg, cc)
    local CONSOLE = ConsoleClone or Console
	repeat task.wait() until ConsoleQueue:IsEmpty()
	msg = tostring(msg)
	local last_color = nil

	msg = msg:gsub('@@(%a+)@@', function(color)
		local colorName = color:upper()
		local rgbColor = colors[colorName]
		if rgbColor then
			local fontTag = string.format('<font color="rgb(%d,%d,%d)">', rgbColor.R * 255, rgbColor.G * 255, rgbColor.B * 255)
			local result = last_color and '</font>' .. fontTag or fontTag
			last_color = colorName
			return result
		else
			return '@@' .. color .. '@@'
		end
	end)

	if last_color then
		msg = msg .. '</font>'
	end
	
	if msg:match('<font color=".+">.+</font>') then
	 if msg:match('<font color=".+"></font>') == msg then MessageColor = colors[last_color] return end
	end
	
	local tmp = MessageTemplate:Clone()
	tmp.Parent = CONSOLE.ConsoleFrame.Holder
	tmp.Text = msg
	tmp.Visible = true
	tmp.TextColor3 = cc and cc or MessageColor
end
funcs.rconsoleinput = function()
    local CONSOLE = ConsoleClone or Console
    repeat task.wait() until ConsoleQueue:IsEmpty()
    ConsoleQueue:Queue('input')
    local box = InputTemplate:Clone()
    local val
    box.Parent = CONSOLE.ConsoleFrame.Holder
    box.Visible = true
    box.TextEditable = true
    box.TextColor3 = MessageColor

    box.FocusLost:Connect(function(a)
     if not a then return end
     val = box.Text
     ConsoleQueue:Update()
    end)

    local FOCUSED = false
    while true do
     if box.Text:sub(#box.Text, #box.Text) == '_' or box.Text == '' or not box:IsFocused() then
        box.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        box.Text = box.Text .. '_'
        
        for _ = 1, 100 do
            task.wait(1/2)
            if box:IsFocused() then
                FOCUSED = true
                box.TextColor3 = MessageColor
                break
            end
            box.Text = box.Text:sub(#box.Text, #box.Text) == '_' and box.Text:sub(#box.Text-1, #box.Text-1) or box.Text .. '_'
        end
        if FOCUSED then break end
     else
        task.wait(0.1)
     end
    end
    repeat task.wait() until val
    return val
end
